verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents that its MCP server lets AI agents act on your behalf with access governed by existing Sumsub role permissions, and team members can be assigned roles. App tokens are mentioned for integrations. That implies agent access can be limited through role-based permissions, but nothing shows purpose-built, scoped API credentials issued per agent. Missing for 10: explicit per-token permission scopes for API/app tokens, documentation on issuing dedicated least-privilege credentials for agents, token rotation/expiry controls, independent corroboration.
